perks.name: Wrecker
perks.description: You deal significantly increased Kinetic damage to combatant shields, overshields, vehicles, and constructs. Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.
perks.exact:
Passively grants increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields, Overshields, Vehicles, and Constructs.
200% increased Kinetic Damage towards Combatant Shields and Combatant Overshields. Damage shows up as Yellow Numbers.
15% increased Kinetic Damage towards Constructs. Koregos is not a Construct lol
It's ALL Kinetic Damage, including Corruption, Praxic Blade, and Unpowered/Glaive Melee!

perks.name: Concussive Rounds
perks.description: Defeating powerful combatants or breaking a combatant shield with Kinetic damage releases a disorienting Kinetic shockwave.
perks.exact:
Upon killing an Elite+ Combatant, or breaking a Combatant Shield with Kinetic Damage:
Triggers a disorienting Kinetic blast, dealing up to 162 Kinetic Damage, heavily staggering, and inflicting disorient to enemies within 10 meters for ? seconds.
